_comment: Claude Code transcript ingest — codesessions.db, the sealed-but-greppable engineering
archive. AUTHORED include-list (2026-08-17): where planner process knowledge was created,
and nothing else — relevance is never auto-detected. Google-Drive-Analysis and Agent-Stats
were considered and excluded (operational sessions, not knowledge-bearing);
projectsRoot can be pointed at the 2026-08-17 snapshot
(Documents\ClaudeCode Projects Snapshot 2026-08-17) to backfill from it; per-session
replace means running against both sources is safe and order-independent.
excludeFirstUserMessage (2026-09-03): AUTHORED regexes; a main session whose first human
user message matches is never ingested, and its subagents go with it. The archive is
provenance for human-in-the-loop sessions only. Programmatic batch children carry none:
on 2026-08-27 a runner's infinite retry of `claude -p /analyze-story` left 9,245
transcripts in the StoryPlanner project dir. There is no delete path, so this rule is what
makes re-running the ingest safe after a manual cleanup. Never run --apply without it.
Autonomous agents now launch from a folder outside the repo with --no-session-persistence
(tools/StoryPlanner.AgentRunner), so future batches never reach an included dir at all.
